meta.name: pyqt-app-skeleton-mvc
meta.description: Create or enforce PyQt project structure with ui/controllers/services/domain separation. Use when desktop app code is overly mixed.

copy.tagline: 用 MVC 模式组织 PyQt 桌面应用代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 PyQt 项目代码混乱、缺乏分层结构
copy.tagline_en: Organize PyQt desktop app code with MVC pattern
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your PyQt project code is messy and lacks layered structure

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你把 PyQt 桌面应用的代码拆分成 ui、controllers、services、domain 四个文件夹，让界面代码只负责显示，逻辑代码放到控制器和服务里。
howto.when: 当你提到 PyQt 桌面应用代码混乱、需要重构，或者要求创建标准 MVC 项目结构时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 MVC 结构重构这个 PyQt 应用。
为我的 PyQt 项目创建标准骨架。
say.note: Claude 会生成文件夹和边界模板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you split PyQt desktop app code into ui, controllers, services, and domain folders, keeping widgets focused on rendering and moving logic to controllers/services.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention PyQt desktop app code is messy, needs refactoring, or ask to create a standard MVC project structure.

say_en.text: Help me refactor this PyQt app using MVC structure.
say_en.note: Claude will split code into ui/controllers/services/domain.

say_en.text: Create a standard skeleton for my PyQt project.
say_en.note: Claude will generate folders and boundary template.
